title: q_max: the 4 old worktrees get a working Neon branch again after the wt- purge
why: Owner item 361 done (11:49 CST Nov 8): his local q_max session deleted 113 wt- Neon branches; 0 remain. His Next note: any of that checkout's 4 worktrees that used a deleted branch has no working database, and the worktree hook gives only a new worktree its own branch. Coordinator 11:50 CST: file as a q_max step (lane for qmax-browser-main-red is archived); it starts when a q_max lane is free. Ruling 332 b keeps cloud sessions off Neon, so the fix runs on the Mac or in the hook.
